_readme: Every sponsor on the site lives in this file.
The logo then replaces the sponsor's name on the tile. Leave "logo" as "" (or
delete the line) and the name shows as text instead.
Logos look best as SVG, or a PNG with a transparent background at least 600px wide.
Sponsor tiles have no description — the sponsor's name appears when you hover
over the tile. "tier" must match a filename in src/content/sponsorship-tiers/:
bronze, silver, gold, or platinum. "order" sorts tiles within a tier, low to high.
A tier with no sponsors is skipped on the page automatically.
